story_overview.title: Mirror, Mirror
story_overview.author: T. W. Cox
story_overview.premise: A troubled youth, Jaime, wants to understand his identity, but his internal doubts and societal expectations resist. After interacting with an AI mirror, the conflict resolves with the AI offering guidance.
story_overview.concept: A young man encounters an AI mirror that helps him explore his identity.

characters.name: Jaime
characters.characterSketch: A too-tall, too-thin youth struggling with his identity.
characters.appearance: Too tall, too thin, with a swollen cheek and haunted eyes.
characters.psychNotes: Struggling with identity and societal expectations.
characters.backStory: Bullied by classmates, struggling with societal mirrors of identity.

characters.name: Possibility
characters.characterSketch: An AI program designed to reflect and explore potential identities.
characters.appearance: Reflective avatar capable of changing appearance.
characters.physNotes: Digital avatar in a smart wall mirror.
characters.backStory: An AI program that adapts to user needs and reflects potential identities.

settings.name: Men's Room at Discovery Station
settings.summary: A futuristic restroom with a smart wall displaying events and programs.
settings.locale: Public restroom in a futuristic setting
settings.sights: Smart wall, mirror with changing reflections
settings.sounds: Quiet, with the voice of the AI

scenes.name: Jaime confronts his reflection
scenes.description: Jaime stands in front of a smart wall in the men's room, revealing his injured face and tears. He interacts with an AI mirror named Possibility, who offers to help him explore his identity.
scenes.outcome: Jaime is offered guidance by the AI to explore his identity.

problems.name: Jaime's identity crisis
problems.storyQuestion: Will Jaime find out who he truly is?
problems.outcome: The AI offers to help Jaime explore his identity.
